change.title: ao-replay/8714-r2
change.description: fix(artifacts): validate issue destinations and preserve host and focus context
change.author: Aditi Chauhan

findings.title: Parenthesis stripping from the posted name has no stated reason
findings.body: `input.name.replace(/[()]/g, "")` silently changes the filename sent to GitHub (`plan (1).md` is posted as `plan 1.md`), while the dialog still shows the original name. Nothing in the code or PR body says why parentheses are the problem, for example Markdown link syntax in the issue comment. Add a one-line comment naming the reason so the next reader doesn't revert it or extend it to other characters. A name made only of parentheses and an extension, like `().md`, would post as `.md`. `issueArtifactType` runs on the unstripped name, so the type check is unaffected.

contracts.action: Add to GitHub issue now reads artifact content through the session's own host base URL
contracts.equivalent_path: Other artifactContentUrl callers (ArtifactPreviewModal.tsx:137, ArtifactThumbnail.tsx:53, FileMediaPreview.tsx:32, useSessionWorkspaceFiles.ts:362) call it without hostId and use the local API base.
contracts.before_after: Before, a preview-style rawUrl was rewritten against getApiBaseUrl(), the local daemon, even for a remote-host session. Now hostId selects baseUrlForHost(hostId), and an unconnected host returns undefined, which surfaces files.error.loadArtifact. This matches how the same file passes hostId elsewhere.
contracts.visible_effect: Remote sessions upload the remote file's content instead of a 404 or the wrong local file. A disconnected host shows the load-artifact error in the dialog.
contracts.failure_mode: The fetch or a non-OK response rejects the mutation, and add.error is shown in the dialog (GitHubIssueArtifactDialog.tsx:148). Nothing is lost.

contracts.action: Focus returns to the filename button when the issue dialog closes
contracts.equivalent_path: The menu content's onCloseAutoFocus (ArtifactActionsMenu.tsx:367-371) suppresses focus-return for the share panel via sharing.current.
contracts.before_after: Before, the dropdown's focus-restore was suppressed, and the dialog's own restore targeted whatever had focus when it mounted, which is the closing menu. Now the opener element is captured at select time and focused explicitly on close, only if it is still connected.
contracts.visible_effect: Keyboard users land back on the filename button after Escape or Close.
contracts.failure_mode: If filenameButton.current is null, setIssueOpener(null) means the dialog never opens. The button is the DropdownMenuTrigger, so the ref is set whenever the menu content is rendered (DropdownMenuTrigger is Radix Trigger, and React 19 passes the ref). If the opener unmounts, the guard skips focus and the default behaviour applies.

contracts.action: findArtifactIssues validates the repository of a number lookup, and the browser fallback now rejects
contracts.equivalent_path: The search branch already filtered by repository_url. The number branch now shares that predicate.
contracts.before_after: Before, `#12` returned any non-PR row from the path. Now it also requires a matching repository_url, case-insensitive. Rows that lack the field, or whose repository was renamed or transferred, return []. The browser bridge now rejects with an explanatory error instead of returning [].
contracts.visible_effect: The dialog shows the empty or link-hint state for a mismatched issue, or the desktop-required error in a plain browser.
contracts.failure_mode: gh failures reject and are shown via issues.error in the dialog.

summary: The change is small and correct as far as I read it. I found nothing that blocks merging or needs fixing. The one comment is that the parenthesis stripping on the posted artifact name has no stated reason. I did not run any code or tests.
